title: Parameter vs. Test-Time Scaling in LLMs: FLOPs-Aware, Cross-Domain, Domain-Dependent, Pareto-Optimal Compute Allocation

contributions.purpose: 解耦内部推理与外部 CoT 并量化冗余
contributions.mechanism: 用 Gemini thinking_budget=0 开关内部推理,对照外部 CoT,GSM8K/PopQA 双域
contributions.domain: LLM 计算分配 / test-time scaling
contributions.source_quote: the redundancy principle quantifying overlap between internal and external reasoning

contributions.purpose: 建立 FLOPs/成本感知的域特定 Pareto 前沿框架
contributions.mechanism: 标准化 prompt/指标/token 成本核算,固定 seed=42、温度0.7,构造 cost-accuracy 前沿
contributions.evaluation: GSM8K 最优点 Gemini Flash 内部推理 95.36% @ $3.8e-5/样本;CoT 达同精度贵 10-100×
contributions.source_quote: FLOPs-aware, domain-specific cost–accuracy Pareto frontiers that reveal distinct optimization strategies

contributions.mechanism: 按任务类型选策略:数学任务用内部推理或 CoT(勿叠加),知识任务用参数规模+精简 prompt
contributions.evaluation: PopQA:内部推理仅 +6.63pt,CoT 常降精度(GPT-4.1 -5.0pt,Pro -5.27pt);前沿全为 no-CoT 配置
contributions.source_quote: actionable deployment policies that align test-time scaling with task characteristics and model architectures

self_declared_provenance.quote: prior studies rarely offer FLOPs-matched, cross-domain comparisons of these strategies or account for potential redundancy between internal latent reasoning and external prompting. This work fills these gaps

notes: 自声明 3 条贡献。核心含负结果/trade-off:PopQA 上外部 CoT 常同时降精度与成本效率(GPT-4.1 49.55→44.55%,Pro 45.60→40.33%,Flash 40.13→38.35%);内部推理+CoT 叠加经济上无效(Pro +0.23pt 却贵约25×)。透明度佳但 checklist 自认 Q7 统计显著性[No](仅点估计无 CI/检验)、Q8 compute[No]、Q10 broader impacts[No]——多项自曝待补。数据红旗:生成假设(disclosure 附录 Generated Hypothesis)承诺'2.4x'、'>87% 预测框架'、'1B-70B'、'35% 成本降',但实际论文仅测闭源 API、无 uncertainty 预测框架,交付范围远小于生成假设(诚实收窄但暴露 AI 幻想式过度承诺)。checklist AI 披露:hypothesis[D]/analysis[D]/writing[D]、experiments[C];Liner 端到端 agent 生成全稿,图用 ChatGPT-5;AI 自曝'over-confidence—treating incomplete runs as finished'、语义错误(不崩溃但结果错)难定位。匿名代码库 anonymous.4open.science 链接提供。
